415	def deflated_sharpe(per_session, n_trials, sr_var_trials=None):
416	    """Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014): the probability that the per-session Sharpe of a book is above the expected maximum
417	    Sharpe of n_trials trials with variance sr_var_trials (the variance of Sharpe across the family; estimated from
418	    per_session's own scale when None), with the skew / kurtosis correction. Returns SR, SR0, DSR, p = 1 - DSR."""
419	    x = np.asarray(per_session, dtype=float); T_ = len(x)
420	    if T_ < 3 or x.std(ddof=1) == 0: return dict(sr=None, sr0=None, dsr=None, p=None, T=T_)
421	    sr = float(x.mean() / x.std(ddof=1)); g3 = float(sst.skew(x)); g4 = float(sst.kurtosis(x, fisher=False))
422	    V = sr_var_trials if sr_var_trials is not None else 1.0 / T_
423	    N = max(2, n_trials); em = 0.5772156649
424	    sr0 = math.sqrt(V) * ((1 - em) * sst.norm.ppf(1 - 1 / N) + em * sst.norm.ppf(1 - 1 / (N * math.e)))
425	    den = 1 - g3 * sr + (g4 - 1) / 4 * sr * sr
426	    if den <= 0: return dict(sr=round(sr, 4), sr0=round(sr0, 4), dsr=None, p=None, T=T_, note="denominator <= 0")
427	    z = (sr - sr0) * math.sqrt(T_ - 1) / math.sqrt(den)
428	    dsr = float(sst.norm.cdf(z))
429	    return dict(sr=round(sr, 4), sr0=round(float(sr0), 4), dsr=round(dsr, 4), p=round(1 - dsr, 4), T=T_, n_trials=n_trials, skew=round(g3, 3), kurt=round(g4, 3))
430

432	def min_backtest_length(sr, n_trials, sr_var_trials):
433	    """Sessions needed for the observed per-session Sharpe to clear the expected maximum of n_trials (AFML 14.7)."""
434	    N = max(2, n_trials); em = 0.5772156649
435	    sr0 = math.sqrt(sr_var_trials) * ((1 - em) * sst.norm.ppf(1 - 1 / N) + em * sst.norm.ppf(1 - 1 / (N * math.e)))
436	    return round(float((sr0 / sr) ** 2 + 1), 1) if sr > 0 else None

439	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- resampling: stationary block bootstrap of sessions, SPA
440	def stationary_bootstrap_idx(T_, draws=BOOT_DRAWS, mean_block=BOOT_MEAN_BLOCK, seed=SEED, tag=""):
441	    """Politis & Romano stationary bootstrap indices (draws x T_) over T_ ordered sessions; seeded and reproducible."""
442	    rng = np.random.default_rng(int(_sha(f"{seed}|boot|{tag}"), 16) % (2 ** 32))
443	    p = 1.0 / mean_block
444	    starts = rng.integers(0, T_, size=(draws, T_)); cont = rng.random((draws, T_)) >= p
445	    idx = np.empty((draws, T_), dtype=int)
446	    idx[:, 0] = starts[:, 0]
447	    for t_ in range(1, T_):
448	        idx[:, t_] = np.where(cont[:, t_], (idx[:, t_ - 1] + 1) % T_, starts[:, t_])
449	    return idx

452	def bootstrap_ci(vec, draws=BOOT_DRAWS, ci=GO["boot_ci"], tag=""):
453	    """Block-bootstrap CI (sessions resampled) of the kept-vs-skipped difference and of the kept mean from a session_vectors dict."""
454	    T_ = len(vec["sessions"]); idx = stationary_bootstrap_idx(T_, draws, tag=tag)
455	    ks, kn, ss, sn = (vec[k][idx].sum(axis=1) for k in ("kept_sum", "kept_n", "skipped_sum", "skipped_n"))
456	    with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
457	        km = np.where(kn > 0, ks / kn, np.nan); sm = np.where(sn > 0, ss / sn, np.nan); d = km - sm
458	    a = (1 - ci) / 2
459	    q = lambda v: [round(float(np.nanquantile(v, a)), 2), round(float(np.nanquantile(v, 1 - a)), 2)]
460	    return dict(draws=draws, ci=ci, diff_ci=q(d), kept_mean_ci=q(km), diff_p_le0=round(float(np.nanmean(d <= 0)), 4),
461	                diff_point=round(float(np.nansum(vec["kept_sum"]) / max(1, vec["kept_n"].sum()) - np.nansum(vec["skipped_sum"]) / max(1, vec["skipped_n"].sum())), 2))

464	def selection_gain(vec):
465	    """Per-session selection gain d_t = kept mean in session t minus the session's mean over all units (0 when nothing kept):
466	    the per-session statistic behind the session-matched random control (its expectation under random selection is 0)."""
467	    with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
468	        km = np.where(vec["kept_n"] > 0, vec["kept_sum"] / vec["kept_n"], np.nan)
469	        am = vec["all_sum"] / vec["all_n"]

474	def spa(vectors, draws=BOOT_DRAWS, tag="", min_active=None):
475	    """White's Reality Check and Hansen's SPA over a family of candidates: H0 = no candidate has positive expected selection
476	    gain (per-session kept mean minus the session mean). Stationary bootstrap of sessions, Hansen's consistent recentring;
477	    reported both studentised (Hansen) and unstudentised (White's original statistic, sqrt(T) x mean). A candidate whose
478	    selection gain differs from zero in fewer than `min_active` sessions (default max(10, 5% of T)) is excluded from the
479	    studentised family: its near-zero variance would give it an arbitrarily large t (the exit-policy refuter's finding); it
480	    stays in the unstudentised family. Returns the best candidate under each statistic and the four p-values."""
481	    Dm = np.array([selection_gain(v)[0] for v in vectors], dtype=float)       # M x T
482	    M, T_ = Dm.shape
483	    if min_active is None: min_active = max(10, int(0.05 * T_))
484	    active = (np.abs(Dm) > 1e-9).sum(axis=1)
485	    ok = active >= min_active
486	    mu = Dm.mean(axis=1); sd = Dm.std(axis=1, ddof=1) + 1e-12
487	    idx = stationary_bootstrap_idx(T_, draws, tag=tag)
488	    mub = np.stack([Dm[:, idx[d]].mean(axis=1) for d in range(draws)])           # draws x M
489	    sdb = np.stack([Dm[:, idx[d]].std(axis=1, ddof=1) for d in range(draws)]) + 1e-12
490	    thr = np.sqrt(np.var(Dm, axis=1, ddof=1) / T_ * 2 * math.log(math.log(T_)))
491	    mu_c = np.where(mu < -thr, mu, 0.0)                                            # Hansen's consistent recentring
492	    out = dict(candidates=M, sessions=T_, draws=draws, min_active_sessions=int(min_active), excluded_from_studentised=int((~ok).sum()))
493	    # unstudentised (White 2000): statistic sqrt(T) x mean gain, every candidate
494	    tu = np.sqrt(T_) * mu; bu = int(np.argmax(tu)); stat_u = float(tu[bu])
495	    rc_u = np.max(np.sqrt(T_) * (mub - mu), axis=1); spa_u = np.max(np.sqrt(T_) * (mub - mu + mu_c), axis=1)
496	    out.update(best_unstudentised=bu, best_mean_gain_unstudentised=round(float(mu[bu]), 2),
497	               rc_p_unstudentised=round(float((rc_u >= stat_u).mean()), 4), spa_p_unstudentised=round(float((spa_u >= stat_u).mean()), 4))
498	    # studentised (Hansen 2005), candidates with enough active sessions
499	    if ok.any():
500	        ts = np.where(ok, np.sqrt(T_) * mu / sd, -np.inf); bs = int(np.argmax(ts)); stat_s = float(ts[bs])
501	        rc_s = np.max(np.where(ok, np.sqrt(T_) * (mub - mu) / sdb, -np.inf), axis=1)
502	        spa_s = np.max(np.where(ok, np.sqrt(T_) * (mub - mu + mu_c) / sdb, -np.inf), axis=1)
503	        out.update(best=bs, best_mean_gain=round(float(mu[bs]), 2), best_t=round(stat_s, 3), best_active_sessions=int(active[bs]),
504	                   rc_p=round(float((rc_s >= stat_s).mean()), 4), spa_p=round(float((spa_s >= stat_s).mean()), 4))
505	    else:
506	        out.update(best=None, best_mean_gain=None, best_t=None, best_active_sessions=None, rc_p=None, spa_p=None)
507	    return out

510	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- structural breaks of the book's own expectancy
511	def _hac_var(x, lag=5):
512	    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float) - np.mean(x); T_ = len(x)
513	    s = float((x * x).sum())
514	    for k in range(1, lag + 1):
515	        w = 1 - k / (lag + 1); s += 2 * w * float((x[k:] * x[:-k]).sum())
516	    return s / T_ / T_                                                             # variance of the mean

519	def chow_mean(x, y, lag=5):
520	    """HAC (Newey-West, Bartlett, lag 5) t-test of a difference of means between two consecutive segments."""
521	    x, y = np.asarray(x, dtype=float), np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
522	    if len(x) < 5 or len(y) < 5: return dict(t=None, p=None, n=[len(x), len(y)])
523	    t_ = (y.mean() - x.mean()) / math.sqrt(_hac_var(x, lag) + _hac_var(y, lag))
524	    return dict(t=round(float(t_), 3), p=round(float(2 * (1 - sst.norm.cdf(abs(t_)))), 4), mean_before=round(float(x.mean()), 2),
525	                mean_after=round(float(y.mean()), 2), n=[len(x), len(y)])
526

528	def bde_cusum(x, k=10):
529	    """Brown-Durbin-Evans CUSUM of recursive residuals of the constant-mean model on the ordered series x: the maximum
530	    crossing of the 5% bands +-0.948 sqrt(T-k) (1 + 2 (r-k)/(T-k)); reports whether the path leaves the band and where."""
531	    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float); T_ = len(x)
532	    if T_ <= k + 2: return dict(break_detected=None)
533	    w = np.array([(x[t_] - x[:t_].mean()) / math.sqrt(1 + 1 / t_) for t_ in range(k, T_)])
534	    sig = w.std(ddof=1)
535	    W = np.cumsum(w) / sig
536	    r = np.arange(k + 1, T_ + 1)
537	    band = 0.948 * math.sqrt(T_ - k) * (1 + 2 * (r - k) / (T_ - k))
538	    ex = np.abs(W) > band
539	    return dict(break_detected=bool(ex.any()), first_crossing_index=int(np.argmax(ex)) + k if ex.any() else None,
540	                max_ratio=round(float(np.max(np.abs(W) / band)), 3), T=T_)

543	def break_tests(T, lag=5):
544	    """The pre-registration step: has the book's per-session expectancy (active sessions, label L1) changed inside IS or at the
545	    IS / OOS boundary? Rolling 60-session mean with block-bootstrap bands, BDE CUSUM, HAC Chow tests per calendar year, and the
546	    one permitted OOS aggregate read: the Chow test at 2026-01-01 (it decides the OOS caveat, never a key)."""
547	    rows = np.arange(T.n)
548	    ses = T.session[rows]; net = T.net[rows]
549	    S = np.array(sorted(set(ses.tolist()))); idx = np.searchsorted(S, ses)
550	    per = np.bincount(idx, weights=net, minlength=len(S)) / np.bincount(idx, minlength=len(S))
551	    day = dict(zip(T.session, T.day)); days = np.array([day[int(s)] for s in S])
552	    is_ = days <= IS_END
553	    x_is = per[is_]
554	    years = sorted({d[:4] for d in days[is_]})
555	    chow_years = {}
556	    for y in years[1:]:
557	        before = x_is[np.array([d[:4] < y for d in days[is_]])]; after = x_is[np.array([d[:4] == y for d in days[is_]])]
558	        chow_years[y] = chow_mean(before, after, lag)
559	    boundary = chow_mean(x_is, per[~is_], lag)
560	    roll = pd.Series(x_is).rolling(60).mean().to_numpy()
561	    idxb = stationary_bootstrap_idx(len(x_is), 500, tag="roll")
562	    rb = np.array([pd.Series(x_is[idxb[d]]).rolling(60).mean().to_numpy() for d in range(500)])
563	    lo, hi = np.nanquantile(rb, 0.05, axis=0), np.nanquantile(rb, 0.95, axis=0)
564	    outside = int(np.nansum((roll < lo) | (roll > hi)))
565	    return dict(label=T.label, active_is_sessions=int(is_.sum()), is_mean_per_session=round(float(x_is.mean()), 2),
566	                bde=bde_cusum(x_is), chow_per_year=chow_years, chow_is_oos_boundary=boundary,
567	                rolling60_outside_band=outside, rolling60_points=int(np.isfinite(roll).sum()),
568	                winners_only_boundary=chow_mean(x_is[x_is > 0], per[~is_][per[~is_] > 0], lag) if (per[~is_] > 0).sum() >= 5 else None,
569	                caveat=("IS/OOS boundary Chow p < 0.05: the OOS window is not from the same process; every OOS table carries this"
570	                        if boundary["p"] is not None and boundary["p"] < 0.05 else "no boundary break at 5%"))

574	def go_no_go(res, tf, cpcv=None, pbo_value=None, dsr=None, spa_p=None, boot=None):
575	    """The pre-registered pass rule on a candidate's IS results. Returns (passed, {check: (ok, value)})."""
576	    ch = {}
577	    ch["kept_share>=20%"] = (res.get("kept_share") is not None and res["kept_share"] >= GO["kept_share_min"], res.get("kept_share"))
578	    ch[f"kept_n>={GO['kept_n_min'][tf]}"] = (res.get("kept_n", 0) >= GO["kept_n_min"][tf], res.get("kept_n"))
579	    ch["diff>0"] = (res.get("diff") is not None and res["diff"] > 0, res.get("diff"))
580	    ch["diff_top1_removed>0"] = (res.get("diff_top1_removed") is not None and res["diff_top1_removed"] > GO["top1_removed_diff_min"], res.get("diff_top1_removed"))
581	    ch["kept_mean_slip8>0"] = (res.get("kept_mean_slip8") is not None and res["kept_mean_slip8"] > GO["slip8_kept_mean_min"], res.get("kept_mean_slip8"))
582	    ch[f"sign_blocks>={GO['sign_blocks_min']}/12"] = (res.get("sign_blocks") is not None and res["sign_blocks"] >= GO["sign_blocks_min"], res.get("sign_blocks"))
583	    ch["control_pct>=95"] = (res.get("control_pct") is not None and res["control_pct"] >= GO["control_pct_min"], res.get("control_pct"))
584	    if cpcv is not None: ch["cpcv_p5_diff>0"] = (cpcv.get("diff_p5") is not None and cpcv["diff_p5"] > GO["cpcv_p5_diff_min"], cpcv.get("diff_p5"))
585	    if pbo_value is not None: ch["pbo<=0.2"] = (pbo_value <= GO["pbo_max"], pbo_value)
586	    if dsr is not None: ch["dsr_p<0.1"] = (dsr.get("p") is not None and dsr["p"] < GO["dsr_p_max"], dsr.get("p"))
587	    if spa_p is not None: ch["spa_p<=0.10"] = (spa_p <= GO["spa_p_max"], spa_p)
588	    if boot is not None: ch["boot_ci_excludes_0"] = (boot["diff_ci"][0] > 0, boot["diff_ci"])
589	    return all(v[0] for v in ch.values()), ch

1	"""Two facts the null tapes rely on, measured (study null_tapes_drift; 5-minute IS full sessions, engine.run with the Strategy 2 rules):
2	
3	  1. the engine is scale-free: the same bars at 2x the price level give identical swing / CHoCH / BOS / SETUP counts, so the tapes'
4	     random-walk price level cannot change the engine's behaviour (INR statistics still scale with the level; see FINDINGS caveats);
5	  2. what the session bootstrap changes: the CHoCH / SETUP rate of the real IS sessions in their real order, re-based with the real
6	     gaps (identical to the real tape), with random gaps, in shuffled order with the real gap sequence, shuffled with zero gaps, and
7	     in real order with zero gaps. The engine's event rate depends on the multi-day path, which is what a null tape randomises.
8	
9	    python engine_scale_check.py     -> engine_scale_check.json
10	"""
11	import os, sys, json, time
12	sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
13	import numpy as np
14	HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
15	LAB = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, "..", "..", "..", ".."))
16	sys.path.insert(0, HERE); sys.path.insert(0, LAB)
17	import gen_tapes as G, engine                                            # noqa: E402
18	
19	RULES = dict(break_mode="touch", choch_mode="touch", avwap_weight="volume", sl_rule="choch_candle")
20	
21	
22	def counts(O, H, L, C, V):
23	    P, n = O.shape
24	    bars = dict(t=[f"{s:05d} {k:03d}" for s in range(P) for k in range(n)], o=O.ravel().tolist(), h=H.ravel().tolist(), l=L.ravel().tolist(),
25	                c=C.ravel().tolist(), v=V.ravel().tolist())
26	    r = engine.run(bars, RULES)
27	    ch = sum(1 for e in r["events"] if e["kind"] == "CHoCH")
28	    return dict(sessions=P, choch=ch, bos=len(r["events"]) - ch, setups=len(r["setups"]), swings=len(r["sw"]),
29	                choch_per_session=round(ch / P, 4), bos_per_session=round((len(r["events"]) - ch) / P, 4), setups_per_session=round(len(r["setups"]) / P, 4))
30	
31	
32	def chain(fit, order, gaps):
33	    O, H, L, C, V = (fit[k] for k in "OHLCV")
34	    o = np.empty_like(O); h = np.empty_like(O); l = np.empty_like(O); c = np.empty_like(O); v = np.empty_like(O); level = O[order[0], 0]
35	    for s, j in enumerate(order):
36	        lo = level * np.exp(gaps[s]) if s else level
37	        for dst, src in ((o, O), (h, H), (l, L), (c, C)): dst[s] = src[j] / O[j, 0] * lo
38	        v[s] = V[j]; level = c[s, -1]
39	    return o, h, l, c, v
40	
41	
42	def main():
43	    t0 = time.time()
44	    fit = G.fit_generators("5minute", verbose=False)
45	    O, H, L, C, V = (fit[k] for k in "OHLCV"); P = O.shape[0]
46	    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
47	    real_gaps = np.r_[0.0, np.log(O[1:, 0] / C[:-1, -1])]
48	    out = dict(tf="5minute", rules=RULES, pool="IS full sessions (75 bars)", sessions=int(P), runs={})
49	    out["runs"]["real_order"] = counts(O, H, L, C, V)
50	    out["runs"]["real_order_x2_price"] = counts(2 * O, 2 * H, 2 * L, 2 * C, V)
51	    out["runs"]["real_order_rebased_real_gaps"] = counts(*chain(fit, np.arange(P), real_gaps))
52	    out["runs"]["real_order_random_gaps"] = counts(*chain(fit, np.arange(P), rng.choice(fit["gaps"], P)))
53	    out["runs"]["shuffled_sessions_real_gap_sequence"] = counts(*chain(fit, rng.permutation(P), real_gaps))
54	    out["runs"]["shuffled_sessions_zero_gaps"] = counts(*chain(fit, rng.permutation(P), np.zeros(P)))
55	    out["runs"]["real_order_zero_gaps"] = counts(*chain(fit, np.arange(P), np.zeros(P)))
56	    out["scale_free"] = out["runs"]["real_order"] == out["runs"]["real_order_x2_price"]
57	    out["seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
58	    json.dump(out, open(os.path.join(HERE, "engine_scale_check.json"), "w"), indent=1)
59	    print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
60	
61	
62	if __name__ == "__main__":
63	    main()

import os, json, sys
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
S = "/home/user/money-maker/research/strategy_lab/fz_v3/out/studies/null_tapes_drift"
R = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(S, "tape_results.csv"))
RC = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(S, "reality_check.csv"))
null = json.load(open(os.path.join(S, "null_distributions.json")))
fj = json.load(open(os.path.join(S, "findings.json")))
refs = {tf: json.load(open(os.path.join(S, f"real_reference_{tf}.json"))) for tf in ("5minute", "minute")}
print("rows", len(R), "dupes", R.duplicated(subset=["tf", "gen", "k", "gate"]).sum())
print(R.groupby(["tf", "gen"]).k.nunique())
q = lambda v, p: round(float(np.nanquantile(v, p)), 2)
mism = []
n_pass = 0; n_total = 0
for tf in ("5minute", "minute"):
    for gen in ("gmm", "segment", "session"):
        for gate in ("frozen_st7_st8", "choch2_skip", "sl_above_median_skip"):
            s = R[(R.tf == tf) & (R.gen == gen) & (R.gate == gate)]
            dv = s["diff"].to_numpy(float); cv = s["control_pct"].to_numpy(float)
            real = refs[tf]["gates"][gate]["diff"]
            mine = dict(n=len(s), diff_p5=q(dv, .05), diff_p50=q(dv, .5), diff_p95=q(dv, .95), diff_mean=round(float(dv.mean()), 2),
                        diff_min=q(dv, 0), diff_max=q(dv, 1), diff_share_positive=round(float((dv > 0).mean()), 3),
                        control_pct_p50=q(cv, .5), control_pct_p95=q(cv, .95), control_pct_share_ge95=round(float((cv >= 95).mean()), 3),
                        kept_share_p50=q(s.kept_share.to_numpy(float), .5), units_p50=q(s.n.to_numpy(float), .5),
                        real_diff=real, real_above_tape_p95=bool(real > q(dv, .95)),
                        real_diff_percentile_in_tapes=round(float(100 * (dv < real).mean()), 1),
                        tapes_same_sign_as_real=round(float((np.sign(dv) == np.sign(real)).mean()), 3))
            theirs = null["timeframes"][tf]["generators"][gen]["gates"][gate]
            theirs2 = fj["timeframes"][tf]["generators"][gen]["gates"][gate]
            n_total += 1; n_pass += int(theirs["real_above_tape_p95"])
            for k, v in mine.items():
                if theirs.get(k) != v: mism.append((tf, gen, gate, k, v, theirs.get(k)))
                if theirs2.get(k) != v: mism.append(("findings.json", tf, gen, gate, k, v, theirs2.get(k)))
print("gate-null mismatches:", mism if mism else "none")
print("real_above_tape_p95 count:", n_pass, "of", n_total)
# reality
keys = ["ret_std_bps", "ret_kurt_excess", "absret_ac1", "absret_ac2", "absret_ac3", "absret_ac4", "absret_ac5", "choch_per_session", "bos_per_session",
        "setups_per_session", "l1_units_per_session", "l1_mean_net", "l1_win_rate", "frozen_kept_share", "close_last", "atr14_median"]
mm2 = []
for tf in ("5minute", "minute"):
    rcr = RC[(RC.tf == tf) & (RC.gen == "REAL")]
    for gen in ("gmm", "segment", "session"):
        rcg = RC[(RC.tf == tf) & (RC.gen == gen)]
        for kk in keys:
            mine = dict(tape_p50=q(rcg[kk].to_numpy(float), .5), tape_min=q(rcg[kk].to_numpy(float), 0), tape_max=q(rcg[kk].to_numpy(float), 1),
                        real=float(rcr[kk].iloc[0]), ratio_p50_to_real=round(float(np.nanmedian(rcg[kk]) / rcr[kk].iloc[0]), 3))
            theirs = null["timeframes"][tf]["generators"][gen]["reality"][kk]
            for k, v in mine.items():
                if theirs.get(k) != v: mm2.append((tf, gen, kk, k, v, theirs.get(k)))
        ratio = null["timeframes"][tf]["generators"][gen]["reality"]["setups_per_session"]["ratio_p50_to_real"]
        flag = not (1 / 3 <= ratio <= 3)
        if flag != null["timeframes"][tf]["generators"][gen]["poor_null_flag"]: mm2.append((tf, gen, "poor_null_flag", flag))
print("reality mismatches:", mm2 if mm2 else "none")
# real reference vs findings tables
for tf in ("5minute", "minute"):
    for gate, v in refs[tf]["gates"].items():
        t = fj["timeframes"][tf]["real_reference"][gate]
        bad = {k: (v[k], t.get(k)) for k in v if v[k] != t.get(k)}
        if bad: print("real_reference mismatch", tf, gate, bad)
# drift perm quantiles
for src in ("drift_5minute.json", "drift_minute.json", "drift.json"):
    d = json.load(open(os.path.join(S, src)))
    for tf, dd in d["timeframes"].items():
        for name, var in dd["variants"].items():
            pa = np.array(var["perm_aucs"])
            calc = (round(float(np.median(pa)), 4), round(float(np.quantile(pa, .95)), 4), round(float(pa.max()), 4), len(pa))
            rep = (var["perm_auc_p50"], var["perm_auc_p95"], var["perm_auc_max"], var["n_perm"])
            print(src, tf, name, "auc", var["auc_oof"], "perm calc", calc, "reported", rep, "OK" if calc == rep else "MISMATCH")
        top = dd["top20_drifted"]
        print(src, tf, "top5_sources calc", sorted({r["source"] for r in top[:5]}), "reported", dd["top5_sources"])
        ranks = [r["mean_abs_shap"] for r in top]
        print("  ranked descending:", all(ranks[i] >= ranks[i + 1] for i in range(len(ranks) - 1)))
# compare drift.json to the per-tf files
d5 = json.load(open(os.path.join(S, "drift_5minute.json"))); dm = json.load(open(os.path.join(S, "drift_minute.json"))); dj = json.load(open(os.path.join(S, "drift.json")))
print("drift.json 5minute == drift_5minute.json:", dj["timeframes"]["5minute"] == d5["timeframes"]["5minute"])
print("drift.json minute == drift_minute.json:", dj["timeframes"]["minute"] == dm["timeframes"]["minute"])
print("findings.json drift == drift.json:", fj["drift"] == dj)
# per-tf drift features csv top-5 vs json
for tf in ("5minute", "minute"):
    D = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(S, f"drift_{tf}_features.csv"))
    print(tf, "features csv rows", len(D), "top5", D.head(5).feature.tolist(), "cols in csv with |shap|>0:", int((D.mean_abs_shap > 0).sum()))
    d = dj["timeframes"][tf]
    print("   variant B columns", d["variants"]["B_without_time_proxies"]["columns"], "== csv rows?", d["variants"]["B_without_time_proxies"]["columns"] == len(D))
    print("   A-B =", round(d["variants"]["A_all_asof"]["auc_oof"] - d["variants"]["B_without_time_proxies"]["auc_oof"], 4))

        bad = {k: (m[k], r[k]) for k in keys if m[k] != r[k]}
        print("  ", name, "diff", m["diff"], "ledger", r["diff"], "mismatch:" if bad else "all match", bad if bad else "")
    # drift label counts
    y = (T.day > "2023-09-30").astype(int)
    print("  drift early/late:", int((y[rows] == 0).sum()), int((y[rows] == 1).sum()))
    # earliest/latest IS day; block membership of the boundary
    print("  IS day range", T.day[rows].min(), T.day[rows].max())

    bl = T.block[rows]

    top = sorted(rho.items(), key=lambda kv: -abs(kv[1]))[:12]
    print("  design cols", Xdf.shape[1], "top |rho| with session_idx:", [(c, round(v, 3)) for c, v in top])

    Freal = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT, "data", tf, "features.parquet"))
    tf_folders = tapes.tape_folders(tf)
    Ft = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(tf_folders[0], "features.parquet"))
    print("  real features cols", Freal.shape[1], "tape cols", Ft.shape[1], "same set:", set(Freal.columns) == set(Ft.columns))
    print("  tape split values:", Ft.split.astype(str).value_counts().to_dict(), "n tape folders", len(tf_folders))
    # is fz_traded / n_choch_since_bos / sl_dist_atr in asof columns?
    ac = set(T.asof_columns())
    print("  asof has fz_traded:", "fz_traded" in ac, "n_choch_since_bos:", "n_choch_since_bos" in ac, "sl_dist_atr:", "sl_dist_atr" in ac, "sl:", "sl" in ac, "n_events_asof:", "n_events_asof" in ac)
    # sessions on the tape
    St = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(tf_folders[0], "sessions.parquet"))
    print("  tape sessions", len(St), "date range", St.date.astype(str).min(), St.date.astype(str).max(), "split", St.split.astype(str).value_counts().to_dict())
    # real level over IS (mean close) vs tapes' mean close
    Breal = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT, "data", tf, "bars.parquet"), columns=["close", "split"])
    print("  real IS mean close", round(float(Breal[Breal.split.astype(str) == "IS"].close.mean()), 1))
    mc = []
    for fo in tf_folders:
        b = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(fo, "bars.parquet"), columns=["close"]); mc.append((os.path.basename(fo), round(float(b.close.mean()), 0)))
    df = pd.DataFrame(mc, columns=["tape", "mean_close"]); df["gen"] = df.tape.str.rsplit("_", n=1).str[0]
    print("  tape mean close by gen (p50/min/max):", df.groupby("gen").mean_close.agg(["median", "min", "max"]).round(0).to_dict("index"))

content.subject: Rebuild both datasets (1m, 5m) from fz_v3/data via engine.load; cross-check against fz_v3/built; write QUALITY.md

Compare SETUP counts, trades, room card against fz_v3/built; the cloud rebuild wins; log discrepancies in fz_v3/out/QUALITY.md.

content.subject: Validation harness: splitter (12 IS blocks, purge by label exit, 3-session embargo), CPCV paths, append-only ledger via score(), PBO, DSR, block bootstrap, SPA
content.description: fz_v3/out/harness.py: the single evaluator. Every gate candidate goes through score(); kept-vs-skipped expectancy, session-matched random control (fz_report.random_control), permutation p (fz_report.permutation_p), CPCV 11 paths, go/no-go rule (PBO <= 0.2, CPCV p5 diff > 0, DSR p < 0.1, kept share >= 20%, kept n >= 300/80, top-1%-removed value > 0, slippage 8 pts survival). Break tests (BDE CUSUM, Chow) as pre-registration.

content.subject: Feature vocabulary pass: clustered MDA/MDI/SFI, FFD, BSADF/CUSUM, BOCPD run length, novelty scalars, SHAP interactions; freeze <= 8 clusters
content.description: quant-ml-canon-feature-importance merged with the feature contributions of regime-breaks, regime-states (BOCPD, GMM), motif (nn_dist_prefix, p1_dist_prefix), rocket window summaries. Per-year stability filter. Shortlist frozen in the ledger before any gate search.

content.subject: H1-H5 classical studies through the harness (gate audit, regime, volume, levels, learned gate) on IS
content.description: H1 what ST7/ST8 skip (precision/recall as loser filter, big winners); H2 regime grid; H3 visibly-high-volume reaction; H4 level respect vs break; H5 depth-3 tree + greedy rule list + GBM ceiling. All IS, via score(), every trial in the ledger.

content.subject: Learned-gate family: meta-labelling + full-information policy tree, distilled to rule list / scorecard; regime states; LLM hypotheses (round 0 blind, round 1 cross-fitted); FQI exit; session stop; conformal operating point; sizing
content.description: DESIGN_PANEL merged program: meta-label gate (L1 label, winsorised |net| weights, HGB/bagging ceilings, scorecard, rule list), policy trees, GMM/HMM/BOCPD regime states, LLM-hypothesis rounds with family-wise max-T permutation, FQI exit policy (learner C grid, B hindsight imitation, A FQI), session stop rule with within-session x hour null, conformal skip operating point, sizing conditional on a surviving gate, null tapes (5m), adversarial drift.
content.activeForm: Running the learned-gate family and modern-ML studies

content.subject: Walk-forward learn-after-each-trade policy with the trade journal (IS learning curve, continued through OOS); compose with rl.py for exit/size
content.description: fz_learn.py prototype: journal rows per SETUP (features, decision, reason, model state id, fill, exit, MFE/MAE, pts, gross, costs, net, R, running equity/DD/PF); online learners (LinUCB/Thompson on logistic or tree-embedded model, online GBM refits, k-trade cadence); fractional Kelly sizing with max lots and daily loss stop; learning curve vs take-all and random control; deterministic replay.

content.subject: OOS opened once by one script for at most three frozen candidates (rule list, learner, ST7/ST8 comparator)
content.description: fz_v3/out/oos_once.py reads frozen candidate JSON + sha; scores OOS 2026-01-01..2026-09-25 with random control, permutation p, kept-vs-skipped, winner recall; the learner continues updating through OOS as it would live. 1	# FZ v3 cloud datasets (`fz_v3/out/data/<timeframe>/`)
2	
3	Built by `../build/build.py --tf minute | 5minute` from the committed files in `fz_v3/data/` read in full through
4	`engine.load` (never `lab.sessions()`). One column contract for both timeframes. `meta.json` next to the files carries the
5	provenance (data sha, code shas, thresholds, counts, run times); `compare.json` the cross-check against the local build
6	(`fz_v3/built/`); `trunc_<cut>/` the same build on the bars up to the cut with `trunc_diff.json` (the causality check).
7	
8	**Foundation rules:** 1 min = Strategy 1 (`prev_swing` stop), 5 min = Strategy 2 (`choch_candle` stop); `break_mode touch`,
9	`choch_mode touch`, `avwap_weight volume`. **FZ block:** the frozen ST7 (1 min) / ST8 (5 min) `fz` block, memory from bar 0.
10	**Costs:** lot 65, 5 pts slippage per side, `lab.trade_charges(ZERODHA_NFO_FUT)` on the slipped prices (`net = pts x 65 -
11	cost`). **Split:** IS = SETUP date <= 2025-12-31, OOS = 2026-01-01 .. 2026-09-25.
12	
13	## Look-ahead vocabulary
14	
15	- **as-of**: computed from bars `<= k` (the SETUP bar) and engine / FZ state as of that bar's close. Feature-eligible.
16	- **label**: uses bars after `k`. Never a feature: prefixes `fnd_`, `l1_`, `fwd_`, `fzpos_`, `fzpost_`, and `fz_traded`.
17	- **final-state**: a value that keeps changing until the data end (`swings.broken_final`, `events.window_end`,
18	  `fz_zones.retired_*`, `fz_visits.end*`). Usable only through a bar-indexed condition (`birth_bar <= k < retired_bar`).
19	
20	`harness.Table.asof_columns()` is the allow-list (label prefixes, identities, raw prices and ids removed).
21	
22	## `features.parquet` — one row per Foundation SETUP (261 columns)
23	
24	`sg` = +1 for `dir = up`, -1 for `dir = down`; `k` = `setup_i`; `a` = `atr14` at `k` (Wilder 14 on the futures bars, `lab.atr_series`);
25	"1h" / "3h" = 60 / 180 bars on 1 min, 12 / 36 bars on 5 min; None / NaN = not defined.
26	
27	### identity and clock (as-of)
28	| column | definition |
29	|---|---|
30	| `setup_i`, `time`, `date`, `session_idx`, `session_bar`, `hhmm`, `hour`, `minute_of_day`, `dow` | the SETUP bar and its clock (bar open time; `dow` 0 = Monday) |
31	| `hour_bin` | `fz_report.crosstabs` bins with the frozen clocks: `<09:25`, `09` .. `15`, `>=15:20` |
32	| `dir`, `dir_sign` | SETUP direction |
33	| `choch_i`, `choch_time`, `bars_since_choch`, `choch_flip`, `choch_trend_before`, `choch_same_session` | the SETUP's own CHoCH |
34	| `open`, `high`, `low`, `close`, `contract`, `days_to_expiry` | the SETUP bar; the near-month contract and calendar days to its expiry |
35	| `split`, `in_warmup` | IS / OOS; session index < the strategy's `warmup_days` (flagged, not dropped) |
36	| `traded`, `engine_skipped` | the engine took / skipped the SETUP (wrong-side stop; 0 rows on both files) |
37	| `sl`, `sl_dist_pts`, `sl_dist_atr` | the Foundation stop at the SETUP close and its distance (`sg x (close - sl)`) |
38	
39	### price window (as-of; all windows stop at the session's first bar: the overnight gap never enters)
40	| column | definition |
41	|---|---|
42	| `atr14`, `atr_bps` | ATR14; `1e4 x atr14 / close` |
43	| `range_1h_pts`, `range_1h_atr`, `range_3h_pts`, `range_3h_atr` | max high - min low over the last 1h / 3h of bars of this session ending at `k` |
44	| `range_since_choch_atr` | the same over bars `choch_i .. k` |
45	| `bar_range_pts`, `bar_body_pts`, `bar_range_atr`, `close_pos_in_bar` | the SETUP bar's range, body (`close - open`), range / a, `(close - low) / (high - low)` |
46	| `sess_open`, `close_vs_sess_open_pts`, `sess_range_atr`, `pos_in_session_range` | the session's open; the session so far: range / a, where the close sits in it (0 = at the low) |
47	| `gap_pts`, `prev_close` | `sess_open -` the previous session's last close |
48	| `ret_1h_pts`, `ret_3h_pts` | `close[k] - close[k - N]` when `k - N` is in the session, else NaN |
49	| `er_1h` | Kaufman efficiency ratio of the closes over the last hour of the session (at least 6 bars) |
50	
51	### regime from the engine's event stream (as-of; events with bar `<= k`, the SETUP's own CHoCH included)
52	| column | definition |
53	|---|---|
54	| `n_events_asof` | events (BOS + CHoCH) up to `k` |
55	| `n_choch_since_bos` | CHoCH events after the last BOS (all CHoCHs when no BOS yet); `>= 2` = "CHoCH, CHoCH, no BOS" |
56	| `n_choch_since_bos_today` | the same restricted to this session's events |
57	| `n_flip_since_bos`, `n_bos_since_choch` | of those CHoCHs, the trend flips; BOS events after the last CHoCH |
58	| `bars_since_bos`, `last_bos_dir`, `last_bos_same_session` | the last BOS (NaN / `none` before the first) |
59	| `bars_since_prev_choch`, `last_choch_dir` | the CHoCH before the latest one; the latest CHoCH's direction |
60	| `alt_dir6`, `alt_kind6`, `last6_kinds` | direction changes / kind changes among the last 6 events; the last 6 as `Cu Cd Bu ...` |

This is the memory of the run. A fresh session resumes from here: read this file, `README.md`, `STUDY_AGENT_BRIEF.md`,
`QUALITY.md`, then the `studies/*/FINDINGS.md` named below. Branch `research/strategy-lab-pwxiug`, base 39eff00 of
`research/strategy-lab`; every commit so far is local only (git push and the GitHub API both refuse with 403: the Claude GitHub
App is not installed on kiran6154/money-maker; the owner must install it at https://github.com/apps/claude/installations/select_target).

## Protocol (unchanged, pre-registered)
IS 2021-10-01..2025-12-31, OOS 2026-01-01..2026-09-25 opened once by `oos_once.py` for at most three sha-registered candidates.
Label L1 = the 15:25 intraday book (the one ST13/ST14 would trade), L0 = the engine's uncut trade (robustness). Judgement = the
kept-vs-skipped difference, session-matched random control, permutation p, winner recall, top-1%-removed, slippage-8 kept mean,
block sign test, CPCV 5th percentile, PBO, DSR, SPA, bootstrap CI (`harness.go_no_go`). Every trial is a ledger row
(`ledger/trials.jsonl`, 1,527 rows at the time of writing; `ledger/registrations.jsonl` holds the hashed pre-registrations).

## Done (verified by two adversarial refuters each, repaired once where a material issue was confirmed)

| step | where | result |
|---|---|---|
| datasets rebuilt from `fz_v3/data/` (both timeframes, one column contract, L1 label) | `build/`, `data/`, `QUALITY.md` | identical to the local build on every engine / FZ table; causality diff PASS |

## Interruption (2026-09-29 12:00-16:30 IST) and resume

- **Usage limit.** At about 12:00 IST every running agent failed with the model's usage limit: phase 1 `repair:session_stop` and
